title: Magic UI
notes:
Approved seed. The homepage describes Magic UI as a UI library for design engineers: 150+ free and open-source animated components and effects, built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Motion, as a companion to shadcn/ui. The docs say the components, blocks, and templates are for landing pages and marketing materials. license is free from that public description.
